=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/internal-check-failure-triage.yml:entire file (30 lines) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The checkout lacks the `workflow_run` trigger and `triage-workflow-run` job, and the existing triage job lacks its `check_run` event guard.
  WHY: With only a `check_run` trigger, Actions workflow failures never reach triage, defeating the stated purpose.
- workflow-templates/ai-check-failure-triage.yml:entire file (36 lines) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The checkout lacks the `workflow_run` trigger and `triage-workflow-run` job, and the existing triage job lacks its `check_run` event guard.
  WHY: Consumer repos will not triage Actions workflow failures through `workflow_run`.
- tests/test_ci_failure_workflow_run_triggers.py:file does not exist | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The test file that pins workflow-run trigger behavior, wrapper predicates, deduplication, and heal-intake filtering is absent.
  WHY: The stated verification artifact is missing, leaving those behaviors without contract-level regression protection.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:line 62 (after RELEASE_WORKFLOW_NAMES) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `MAIN_CI_WORKFLOW_NAMES` and the CI-specific `compose_issue_body` branch are absent.
  WHY: A failed `CI` push on `main` would receive release/promotion intro text instead of the mandated CI-specific wording.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:line 31 (after RELEASE_WORKFLOW_NAMES) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `CI` workflow is absent from the `workflow_run.workflows` list, and the intake condition lacks the CI-on-main branch filter.
  WHY: A failed CI push on `main` will not enter the heal-intake job.
- workflow-templates/ai-check-failure-triage.yml:line 30 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The triage job retains `secrets: inherit` instead of passing only the four explicit secrets.
  WHY: All repository secrets cross the reusable-workflow boundary, widening the credentials reachable by the triage job.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:431 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The exit status of `gh issue create` is not explicitly checked before its output is assigned to `triage_issue_url`.
  WHY: If the command fails unexpectedly, the output may be invalid or empty and the post-hoc non-empty check may not reliably prevent proceeding with invalid data.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
